## Invited and topic-contributed sessions, short courses

We are pleased to announce that the calls for invited and topic-contributed sessions as well as short courses are now open:

- [Invited sessions](https://forms.gle/JwmWVzCDTVDsXjhp8)
- [Topic-contributed sessions](https://forms.gle/uGpSh89nbCDEQbzF9)
- [Short courses](https://forms.gle/Ai2H1gwDscnDWbFq9)

Deadline for all three categories is Friday, December 11^th^, 2026 with notification of acceptance by Wednesday, December 23^rd^, 2026.

If you have questions regarding the calls, please contact us at [organizers\@roes2027.org](mailto:organizers@roes2027.org){.email}
